BLOATED_MITHRIL_GRUBBER_15 }} '''Mithril Grubbers''' are a group of {{Uncommon}} [[Sea Creature]]s that can be fished up in {{zone|Abandoned Quarry}} located within the [[Dwarven Mines]] island. == Spawning == '''Mithril Grubbers''' can be fished up in {{zone|Abandoned Quarry}} located within the [[Dwarven Mines]] island. They require {{skl|fishing|level VI (6)}} or higher to be fished up.
